_readme: Where `fund fill` takes each single-brace placeholder ({SPLIT_ADDRESS}, {DEMO_URL}, ...) in an application's draft.md. Keys are application slugs; '*' applies to every application that uses the placeholder. Sources: deploy (deployments.json: field address | proof = proofTxs[0] | memo = memoTxs[0]; networks are tried in order and the first recorded one wins), network-label (the label of the network the same chain/networks pair resolved to), campaign (client/public/shelter-payouts/campaign.json path), value (funding/framework/fill-values.json, filled by a person). A value in fill-values.json under the same key always wins, globally or under the slug. Mainnet only unless a testnet is listed on purpose. `_fallbacks` (per application, applied only with --fallbacks): when any key in when_missing cannot be resolved, the exact sentence `find` (outside comments) is replaced by `replace`, so an entry can be submitted truthfully before that value exists.

DEMO_URL.how: upload funding/media/out/demo-<entry>.mp4 (YouTube unlisted or Loom), paste the URL into fill-values.json

PITCH_VIDEO_URL.how: record the 2-3 min pitch in your own voice, upload, paste the URL into fill-values.json

SHELTER_WALLET.how: client/public/shelter-payouts/campaign.json shelter.wallet; must equal PROOF_SHELTER used in the wave

ARC_TX.how: first sponsored treat on Arc mainnet: tap 'Send Pink Paw a rescue treat' once the backend is live, copy the tx hash from the receipt page URL

TEMPO_TX.how: a:ingest does not record the manual disburseWithMemo call: paste its hash into fill-values.json as TEMPO_TX (check it with cast receipt <tx> --rpc-url $RPC_TEMPO_MAINNET)

ROBINHOOD_SPLIT.how: the USDG instance from the mainnet wave; no token filter, so a manual fund a:record (which sets no token) also counts

_fallbacks.find: A cat-rescue game feeds the same contract on Arc: a one-tap sponsored treat to Pink Paw, with a public receipt.
_fallbacks.replace: A cat-rescue game's one-tap sponsored treat to Pink Paw, on the same contract on Arc, is built and switching on now.

_fallbacks.find: It runs on the Arc instance of the same contract today.
_fallbacks.replace: It is built on the Arc instance of the same contract and is switching on now; no treat has been paid yet.

_fallbacks.find: {ARC_NETWORK}: the same contract at {SPLIT_ADDRESS}, where the first sponsored treat to Pink Paw is transaction {ARC_TX}, listed on the payouts page.
_fallbacks.replace: {ARC_NETWORK}: the same contract at {SPLIT_ADDRESS}. Sponsored treats pay through the Arc instance once they switch on, and every treat will be listed on the payouts page.

X402_URL.how: after the Oct 12-14 build: the public https URL of the paid x402 endpoint (it must answer 402)

PAY_TX.how: the first agent payment settled on mainnet through the facilitator: paste its tx hash

VIDEO_URL.how: upload the 2 min x402 video (YouTube unlisted or Loom), paste the URL

X402_CHAIN.how: the mainnet the facilitator settles on, as a judge reads it, e.g. Base
